titulo: Philips Hue adds Nanoleaf’s light panels to its ecosystem with a $40 module
cuerpo: Philips Hue is finally adding wall panels into its smart lighting portfolio. But instead of developing its own, it's partnered with longtime rival Nanoleaf, the company that invented the smart modular wall panel category.
